content:
This week, Apple launched its next-generation M6 chip in the new Mac mini, but several more products are also expected to upgrade to M6 soon. Here's the rumored release timeline for M6 Macs and iPads.

Fall 2026: MacBook Pro and iMac

Expected this fall (around October), Apple will release two more Macs equipped with the M6:

  • MacBook Pro
  • iMac

The MacBook Pro will only come in a 14-inch base model. According to Mark Gurman, Apple will skip the M6 Pro and Max variants, so only the entry-level MacBook Pro will upgrade to M6. The next batch of Pro-tier chips won't arrive until the M7 Pro and M7 Max in 2027.

Apple's all-new iMac isn't expected to change much beyond the M6 chip — the only rumored upgrade is the addition of a few new color options. Still, going from M4 to M6 makes the new model worth upgrading to.

Worth noting, the rumored MacBook Ultra isn't on this list. It's expected to launch in the fall, but with M5 Pro and M5 Max chips instead of M6.

Spring 2027: iPad Pro and MacBook Air

The first products rumored to upgrade to M6 in 2027 include:

  • iPad Pro
  • MacBook Air

Apple last updated the iPad Pro in fall 2025, when it jumped to the M5 chip. Following the rumored spring 2027 update, the product will return to its usual 18-month upgrade cycle.

Beyond the M6 chip upgrade, Apple's new iPad Pro is expected to feature a vapor chamber thermal design, which can improve sustained performance on this ultra-thin machine.

The MacBook Air with M6 is expected to launch around the same time as the iPad Pro. February through April are all possible, but based on Apple's track record, March is the safest bet.

Beyond the chip upgrade, there's little rumored for the new MacBook Air. It should carry over the same design as the M5 model, and reports indicate the OLED upgrade won't come until 2028 at the earliest, so the display will very likely remain unchanged.

One potential benefit of the M6 for iPad Pro and MacBook Air is longer battery life. Apple says the 2-nanometer process used in the M6 delivers "a major leap in performance and energy efficiency."

Which of these M6 products are you planning to upgrade to? Why? Feel free to share with us in the comments.
